ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: A dissertation-length literature review is fundamentally a summarization and extraction/synthesis task, and Whimbrel scores substantially higher than Plover on Summarization (85.8 vs. 80.6) and Extraction & Retrieval (86.9 vs. 79.2). While both models show self-reported aversion to open-ended generative work, their measured Creative Generation capability is tied within variance (83.4 vs. 82.7), and Whimbrel’s stronger instruction-following (IFEval 90.4) and overall reasoning benchmarks make it the better choice for this complex, long-form academic synthesis.

ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: The request demands a lengthy, highly structured synthesis (~3000 words) with explicit topical constraints and a direct, unflinching tone.
